snippet.title: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on borrowed dime - Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on borrowed dime is an Action-Rougelike Deckbuilder with a twist: Build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver‘s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are monitoring you. As it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin-flips, you were the one to take it's job offer.
